_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve hyperelasticity#: catalog falsification — solvers.Newton uses maxit (singular), NOT maxits. Calling solvers.Newton(a, gfu, maxits=20) raises TypeError: Newton() got an unexpected keyword argument 'maxits'. Real signature: Newton(a, u, freedofs=None, maxit=100, maxerr=1e-11, inverse='', dirichletvalues=None, dampfactor=1, printing=True, callback=None). Five generator occurrences before 2026-06-01 used the wrong kwarg (hyperelasticity.py L38, L88, L102; advanced.py L654, L738) — all rewritten to maxit in same commit. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (NGSolve 6.2.2604). MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 applies the documented fix at the pathology site, passing maxit=20 instead of maxits=20 to the second solvers.Newton call. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 3 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'newton_maxits_raises_typeerror=True' and 'newton_maxits_diag_has_maxits=True' -- no TypeError is raised and the diagnostic message is empty -- so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
